title: A markup or fee rule
caption: markup_rules / fee_rules: is_active, active_from, active_until, version. The default markup rule (is_default, priority 1000) stays active, has no window and cannot be deleted (409 default_rule). Code: settings/pricing-actions.ts, pricing-rules.ts.

states.label: Active, window not started
states.detail: `is_active` and `active_from` in the future: not applied yet.

states.label: Active and applied
states.detail: Matches the next search's offers by scope and priority.

states.label: Window ended
states.detail: `active_until` passed: no longer applied, still listed.

states.label: Deleted
states.detail: `DELETE` with `If-Match`, no reason; `settings.markupRules.delete` keeps the rule as `before`.

transitions.label: Save with Active unticked (not the default rule)
